column1: # Median `gos check` and cold `gos build --release` wall time in
# milliseconds, three runs. Recorded 2026-08-27 on x86_64 Linux for
# The `check` column is the fold and nothing after it. The `build`
# column is the fold plus the rest of a native build, which is why the
# control still costs something: it is a whole build with no fold in it.
# `ct_heavy` folds in ~129 ms under `check` and reports ~124 ms of
# `comptime_us` under `build --timings`, which is the same single fold -
# the gap between the two commands is the authoritative front end
# running again over the folded source, not a second evaluation.
